subject: English
passage: As textile production techniques expanded throughout medieval trade networks during the 12th and 13th centuries, distinct approaches to fabric dyeing ______ whereas mineral-based dyes became essential to cloth production in Northern Europe and Scandinavia, plant-based extraction methods became dominant among merchant communities of the Mediterranean basin.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation: Choice A is the best answer. The convention being tested is punctuation use within a sentence. A colon can be used between two main clauses to signal that what follows is an elaboration of what came before. In this choice, the colon correctly introduces the following explanation of the distinct dyeing approaches that developed.
